# District 6 Elections

States of Jersey elections held in District 6 — St Helier South — since 2022:

- **[Deputies Elections](https://flow.je/elections/district-6#deputies)**

* * *

* * *

## Deputies Elections

The 2022 elections are the first to utilise the new electoral districts.

* * *

### 2022 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy (3 seats), 22nd June 2022.

**[Sam Mézec](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/sam-mezec), [Tom Coles](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/tom-coles), [Beatriz Porée](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/beatriz-poree) and [David Warr](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/david-warr) were elected as Deputies of District 6 in 2022.**

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Sam Mézec](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/sam-mezec)** | Reform Jersey | 955 | 54.2% |
| 2 | **[Tom Coles](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/tom-coles)** | Reform Jersey | 713 | 40.5% |
| 3 | **[Beatriz Porée](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/beatriz-poree)** | Reform Jersey | 679 | 38.6% |
| 4 | **[David Warr](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/david-warr)** | Better Way | 616 | 35% |
| 5 | [Russell Labey](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/russell-labey) |  | 591 | 33.6% |
| 6 | [Judy Martin](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/judy-martin) |  | 496 | 28.2% |
| 7 | [Nick Le Cornu](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/nick-le-cornu) |  | 418 | 23.7% |
| 8 | [Angela Jeune](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/angela-jeune) | Advance Jersey | 277 | 15.7% |
| 9 | [Bernard Manning](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/bernard-manning) |  | 276 | 15.7% |
| 10 | [Chris Hopkins](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/chris-hopkins) |  | 247 | 14% |
| 11 | [Jo Luce](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/jo-luce) | Jersey Alliance | 220 | 12.5% |

1,761 ballots (inc. 22 spoilt papers)

4,761 registered voters

37% turnout

* * *

### 2026 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy (3 seats), 7th June 2026.

- [Tom Coles](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/tom-coles) : Current Deputy of District 6 (Reform Jersey) \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/03/24/st-helier-deputy-launches-re-election-bid/)\]
- [Samantha Gleave](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/samantha-gleave) : New Candidate \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/20/deputy-candidate-seeks-to-provide-independent-voice-in-st-helier/)\]
- [Carla Jardim](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/carla-jardim) : New Candidate (Reform Jersey) \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/20/reform-jersey-complete-bid-to-take-st-helier-south/)\]
- [Bernard Manning](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/bernard-manning) : Previous Candidate \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/19/election-regular-makes-final-states-assembly-bid/)\]
- [Beatriz Porée](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/beatriz-poree) : Current Deputy of District 6 (Reform Jersey) \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/election/2026/04/09/st-helier-deputy-confirms-second-term-bid/)\]
